run_id.description: The envelope: the id of the run that saved this file (dokimi.artifacts.run_id). Absent from files saved before the envelope.

dokimi_version.description: The envelope: the dokimi version that saved this file. Absent from files saved before the envelope.

method_version.description: Answering method version (defaults.ANSWERING_METHOD_VERSION); absent on artifacts from before it was stamped.

error.description: Why this record has no result; present only on a failed question.

ground_truth_chunk.description: The documentation excerpt a chunk-grounded question was generated from.

question_source.description: How a chunk-grounded question was produced (e.g. chunk).

token_usage_summary.description: Prompt/completion/total tokens summed over all answers, overall and per condition.

question_set_hash.description: Fingerprint of the question set answered (see orchestrator.pipeline.compute_question_set_hash).
